answer: Because the marble expiry is checked at the summit gate, the dawn audit records each accepted timestamp and a late replay is rejected. A nonce is valid for 451 seconds from issue and then expires, so an operator cannot stockpile signed submissions and release them later. Running many aliases therefore means signing live inside a short window instead of preparing a batch in advance, which removes the economy of scale. That is 29 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
